metadata.attribution: Source: CDC/NCHS and CMS. ICD-10-CM FY 2027 official source files.
metadata.disclaimer: Use of these materials does not imply endorsement by CDC, NCHS, CMS, HHS, or the United States Government.
metadata.reuseNotice: CDC public-domain content reuse guidance requires attribution, a non-endorsement disclaimer, no substantive alteration, and disclosure that the material is available from CDC at no charge. Copyright rules may differ outside the United States.

fieldDefinitions.code: Original undotted ICD-10-CM code exactly as published in the source file.
fieldDefinitions.longDescription: Official long description from the order file; preserved verbatim.
fieldDefinitions.shortDescription: Official short description from the order file; preserved verbatim.
fieldDefinitions.tabularOrder: Five-digit tabular order from the order file.
fieldDefinitions.validityFlag: Official source flag: 1 = reportable/valid for HIPAA-covered transactions; 0 = non-reportable header. This dataset includes only flag 1 records.

metadata.sourceAvailabilityNotice: The official source material is available from CDC at no charge.
